Gharial.fact: Male gharials mature at 15–18 years of age, when they reach a body length of around 4 m (13 ft) and once the ghara is developed. Gharial.fact: == In culture == The earliest known depictions of the gharial date to the Indus Valley Civilisation.  Seals and tablets show gharials with fish in their mouths and surrounded by fish. A gharial is depicted on one of the rock carvings on a pillar of the Sanchi Stupa, which dates to the 3rd century BC.
